Call right away for backups, alarms, and overflows. Use the service options below for pumping, home-sale evaluations, portable toilet rentals, and commercial support. Call Emergency Dispatch Request Service Choose your service Emergency septic service YOUR SITUATION Backup, overflow, alarm, or strong sewage odor right now. HOW WE HELP Call first for urgent dispatch, then share property details so the crew arrives prepared. Call Emergency Service Routine pumping YOUR SITUATION System is due for pumping before it turns into a failure call. HOW WE HELP Schedule preventive pumping with property location and access notes included up front. Schedule Pumping Well and septic evaluations YOUR SITUATION A buyer, seller, or Realtor deadline is approaching. HOW WE HELP Share the deadline, role, and property access details needed for home-sale scheduling. Family owned and operated. Founded in 1979. Residential and commercial septic service. Well and septic evaluations for home sales. Portable toilet rentals, grease trap cleaning, and lift pump support. Selling a home? Keep evaluations on schedule Buyers, sellers, and Realtors can share deadlines, property access details, and contact handoffs before scheduling starts. • Home-sale requests stay separate from routine pumping so deadlines do not get buried. • Property access, occupancy context, and contact handoffs are gathered before scheduling. • Realtor communication stays centered on timing, not generic service copy. Plan a Home-Sale Evaluation Helpful questions before service How often should a septic tank be pumped? A common planning range is about every three years, but timing depends on tank size, household use, and system condition. What information helps scheduling? Include property address, known tank location, gate or pet notes, and your preferred date so Robinson can schedule more efficiently. What signs mean I should call now? Sewage backup, standing wastewater, strong odors, or sudden drain issues should be handled right away. Can rentals include ongoing service? Yes. Portable rentals can include regular pumping and cleaning for longer projects and events. Need septic help now? Call for emergencies or request routine service. Request Service 24/7 EMERGENCY SERVICE Call Emergency Dispatch ((616) 636-5565) Robinson Septic Cleaning serves West Michigan with emergency response and scheduled septic service. Routine scheduling hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Robinson serves West Michigan with a core footprint around Pierson, Sparta, Cedar Springs, Sand Lake, Trufant, Coral, Howard City, and greater Grand Rapids. 1565 N Dagget Rd, Pierson, MI 49339 Office support line: (616) 887-2060 Services Realtors FAQ Privacy Terms Accessibility
